articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, Vietnam is experiencing a significant dengue outbreak, particularly in Ho Chi Minh City, which has reported 17,718 cases and four fatalities, marking a 64.6% increase from the previous year. In response, the city has implemented a 'dual shield' strategy that combines vector control and vaccination, crucial as the rainy season approaches. Preventive measures include eliminating standing water and promoting vaccination, which offers over 80% protection.
